title: N-glycan remodeling after TANGO2 loss
description: Relative abundances of 82 released N-glycan features in TANGO2 knockout and control cells, with three quantitative columns per genotype.
details: PGC-LC-MS profiling of PNGase F-released, reduced N-glycans examines cellular glycosylation changes associated with TANGO2 loss and altered cytoskeletal organization. The six individual source columns are retained; the figure caption reports five biological replicates for a broader panel but this table contains three per genotype. Likely source topologies are retained with unmarked linkages and bracketed attachments unresolved. The FA3 feature has conflicting shorthand and diagram annotations and therefore lacks typed glycan annotations.
annotation: Likely SNFG topologies transcribed from the source diagrams; uncertain linkages and bracketed terminal parents remain ambiguous. Source row 38 has a label/diagram conflict.
